card.name: Cell culture and cell-line wording
card.fires_on: Words about cells grown in the lab, such as culture, cells and kidney right after monkey or cell, in virus or microbe research text.

modes.label: Culture after cell
modes.description: The word culture following cell in statements about lab antiviral activity.
modes.example: Ribavirin may antagonize the cell<< culture>> antiviral activity of stavudine
